answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond that is slashed when independent audits show it is duplicating another identity’s work or manipulating a vote. Link payouts to verified, distinct contributions, and cap the influence of newly created accounts until they complete a costly review period. A Sybil operator must lock capital across many identities and risk losing it, so scaling a fake swarm becomes expensive rather than a spiral of free accounts toward the summit or zenith of influence. This raises the attacker’s cost; it does not make Sybils impossible.
